how: zlscan serve --port 8765 --lines 6 in the Claude desktop built-in browser (viewport 1024x768)

full_trace_visual.overview: adc.code and afe.v_adc enabled; full run (0-15 ms) rendered as min/max summary envelopes, six scan lines with inter-line gaps and the wedge steps visible; both captions say summary_only
full_trace_visual.zoomed: after three zoom clicks adc.code shows raw-resolution noise over 6562000000-8437000000 ps; afe.v_adc shows the explicit message 'not_recorded · window is finer than recorded summaries; replay it' instead of drawing invented samples

drag_frame_rate.real_mouse_drag: the browser tool's drag delivered 2 input events in 8 ms (an instantaneous jump), so it cannot measure a human drag; no real-drag frame rate was obtained

scripted_proxy.method: page script advanced the cursor slider once per animation frame, 120 updates over the full range, then waited 1.5 s
scripted_proxy.reading: the page kept up with per-frame cursor updates on this display and no stale reply overwrote the final state; requests are asynchronous so this is not end-to-end latency

scope: SIMULATED demo run, short 6-line record, one local machine; not a measured-source or full-size-record check
